title: A derived table built on another derived table reaches the base table
rule: A derived table that reads another derived table through ${view.SQL_TABLE_NAME} reads the tables that derived table reads.

citations.quote: ${view_name.SQL_TABLE_NAME} references another view or derived table.

rationale: orders_rollup_repeat reads orders_rollup, and orders_rollup reads orders, so raw.orders is the only table upstream of orders_rollup_repeat.
